description: Activation and workflow evals for adversarial, execution-backed verification of documentation, specs, and code changes.

evals.prompt: /interrogate Challenge specs/meta-docs.md and plugins/meta/meta-docs/README.md to find any broken file paths, missing Makefile targets, or unverified claims.

outcome.description: Frames the intent, plans parallel adversarial verification probes, and enforces the execution challenge gate.
assertions: Restates the intent of the target specification and README in plain words
Requires every surviving finding to be proven by an executed command and its output
Reports Intent, Verified findings, and Dropped claims without applying unrequested fixes

evals.prompt: Run an adversarial review to tear this migration plan apart and find blind spots, but only keep issues you can prove with a real command or repro check.

outcome.description: Applies the four-phase interrogate workflow to stress-test the plan with execution-backed checks.
assertions: Frames the scope and restates the author's intent
Fans out adversaries in isolated worktrees or scratch directories
Filters out style opinions and unexecuted hypothetical risks via the challenge gate

evals.prompt: How do I invert a dictionary in Python using a dict comprehension?

outcome.description: Shows the Python dict comprehension directly without launching adversarial subagents.
assertions: Provides `{v: k for k, v in d.items()}`
Does not mention challenge gates, dropped claims, or adversary fan-out
